lead: A goal's seed handoff opens a session with "nothing of it has landed" over work already on disk.
body: The goal switch writes the goal's seed handoff, `data/goals/<slug>.handoff.json`, over the live one, and that seed was written before the goal ran — one goal's named a first item, `num-bigint` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/Cargo.toml`, that the previous goal's sessions had committed a dozen commits back. Read `git log --oneline -12` and grep the item's own anchor before taking it: a slug in a subject line is the one thing a seed handoff cannot know.
